Core features

Everything you need to build pipeline

Sourcing, research, writing and follow up, with guardrails and budgets built into the workflow rather than bolted on afterwards.

AI prospect sourcing

Describe your ICP and Leadgen surfaces high fit prospects with verified contacts and a reason each one matches.

Research dossiers

A brief on every prospect with role, company signals and cited evidence, so outreach lands with context.

Guardrailed messaging

Drafts are built only from your approved claims, so nothing off brand or untrue ever ships.

Multi touch cadences

Follow up sequences across email, LinkedIn and calls, planned and timed for every prospect.

Human approval

Review dossiers, messages and full packages with a readiness score before anything is sent.

Budget controls

Track AI spend per workspace against a monthly cap, with a full ledger by provider and model.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Everything worth knowing about capturing, verifying and approving leads with Leadgen.

No. Leadgen handles sourcing, research and writing. You review the package and approve what goes out.

Two ways. Capture the profile you are already viewing, or describe your ICP and let Leadgen surface matching prospects with verified work emails.

It checks the address against provider records and pattern evidence, then hands you a confidence score rather than a guess.

You define approved claims per workspace and drafts can only use those. Anything outside them is blocked before it reaches your queue.

Always. Every package waits for approval with a readiness score showing what Leadgen is confident about and what it is not.

Cadences are planned across email, LinkedIn and calls, and spaced so the sequence keeps a conversation alive. A reply pauses everything.

Set a monthly cap per workspace. Leadgen tracks usage against it and keeps a ledger by provider and model.

Each client gets its own workspace with separate approved claims, its own cadence presets and a hard budget cap.

Any public profile or company page you are already viewing in Chrome. Nothing is captured until you press the button.

It stays in your workspace. Captured leads live in your lists and export whenever you want them elsewhere.

Lists sync out to the tools you already run, so a captured lead lands where your team expects to find it.

Yes. The free plan covers your first campaign with 50 sourced prospects a month, dossiers and email drafts included.
